# Unit User stories

**Unit User:** A Compass operator who books Shifts and approves hours, granted at an org node.

<a id="req-unit-web-0001"></a>

### Unit menu, Home page, and the one-Unit filter

`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0001` · first slice

- **Who:** Unit User
- **What:** The Unit menu lists a Unit User's screens, and Home is the page they land on. A Unit User over several Units can narrow every Unit screen to one Unit.
- **Why:** Each persona gets its own view *(PLT-1: RBAC: unit (buyer), agency (supplier), corporate/program owner)*
- **Sources:** [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) Pages; [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §1 Dashboard / Profile; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) PLT-1

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Unit User menu lists Home, Shifts, Timesheets, Tips, Workers, Agencies, Events, Reports, Uploads, and Setup, in that order.
- **R2.** A Unit User whose scope covers several Units sees them together and can narrow every Unit screen to one Unit, a choice kept from screen to screen until they change it or sign out.
- **R9.** Home is the page a Unit User lands on, first in the menu; it holds only the sections other requirements add, and says there is nothing to do when none has anything to show.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-ORG-0002` Add a Unit and its Departments](business-rules.md#req-org-0002)
- [`REQ-ORG-0009` Allow each action only to its role and scope](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)

**Open questions it rests on**

- [D-64](open-questions.md#d-64) Which screens does a Unit User have?
- [D-107](open-questions.md#d-107) How can the first slice be used before every screen and feature exists?
- [D-121](open-questions.md#d-121) How does a Unit User who covers several Units work across them?

<a id="req-unit-web-0002"></a>

### Book a Request by form

`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0002` · first slice

- **Who:** Unit User
- **What:** A Unit User books a Request on a form with one line for each Position. Each line can be sent to an Agency at its contracted rate as it is booked.
- **Why:** Events need several roles at once *(SC-2: Multiple positions in one request)*
- **Sources:** [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §2 Shifts; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) SC-2; [Demo sessions](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Xy3QVWr-aVVV6mpMxWsH6kb987IzwVPXDQ1iW8k83Bo/edit) Shift Creation

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The form takes one Unit and one or more lines, each with a Position, Department, date, start time, end time, and headcount, and optionally a planned break.
- **R2.** Unit, Position, and Department are picked from active records in the User's scope.
- **R3.** Each line's five site instruction fields start filled from its Department's defaults and can be changed for that line.
- **R4.** An end time earlier than the start asks the User to confirm that the Shift ends the next day before the form can be submitted.
- **R9.** Each line embeds the send step of [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0009`](#req-unit-web-0009) to pick an Agency, or is left unsent.
- **R10.** A line shows the break and minimum-wage flags [`REQ-ORDERING-0002`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0002) returns for its times and picked Agency, and a flag never stops the booking.
- **R11.** Submit creates the Request through [`REQ-ORDERING-0001`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0001), then sends each line that has an Agency through [`REQ-DISPATCH-0001`](business-rules.md#req-dispatch-0001), and opens the Shifts list of [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0007`](#req-unit-web-0007) on the new Shifts.
- **R12.** When [`REQ-ORDERING-0001`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0001) refuses a line, nothing is created and the form marks that line with the check that failed.
- **R13.** When the Request is created but [`REQ-DISPATCH-0001`](business-rules.md#req-dispatch-0001) refuses a send, that Shift stays unsent and the form names the gate or check that refused it.
- **R14.** This requirement adds New Shift to the Shifts list of [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0007`](#req-unit-web-0007), which opens this form.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-ORDERING-0001` Create a Request with one or more Shifts](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0001)
- [`REQ-ORDERING-0002` Show the contracted rate for each Shift line while booking](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0002)
- [`REQ-DISPATCH-0001` Send a Shift's headcount to a chosen Agency](business-rules.md#req-dispatch-0001)

**Open questions it rests on**

- [D-23](open-questions.md#d-23) Do break and minimum-wage checks at booking flag the Shift or block it?
- [D-107](open-questions.md#d-107) How can the first slice be used before every screen and feature exists?
- [D-264](open-questions.md#d-264) Do Departments keep their own check-in instructions?

<a id="req-unit-web-0003"></a>

### Review Timesheets by exception and approve them

`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0003`

- **Who:** Unit User
- **What:** A Unit User sees the Timesheets of their Units with the exception list first. They approve them one at a time, or all those shown for one Shift, one Event, or one work date.
- **Why:**
  - Approvals take too long; operators would comply if it took minutes *(TS-7: Exception-based approval: auto-approve within schedule tolerance, surface the rest on a dashboard)*
  - The true cost of a Monday event shouldn't stay hidden until week end *(TS-8: Daily or per-event timesheet submission and approval, not just at week end)*
  - Edits allowed for up to about 3 weeks make reporting stale *(TS-9: Configurable timesheet lock window (e.g. 24–48 hours after an event))*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) 4.3; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) TS-7; [Demo sessions](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Xy3QVWr-aVVV6mpMxWsH6kb987IzwVPXDQ1iW8k83Bo/edit) Timesheets, Tips & Expenses

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Timesheets screen opens on the exception list of [`REQ-TIME-0005`](business-rules.md#req-time-0005): every SUBMITTED Timesheet in scope, those with OUTSIDE_TOLERANCE first, then the oldest Shift first.
- **R2.** Other tabs list the Timesheets in scope that are DRAFT or REJECTED with the Agency, APPROVED, and locked; every tab filters by Unit, work date, Shift, Event, Agency, and Worker.
- **R3.** Each row shows the Worker, Agency, Shift, Position, Department, the scheduled start and end beside the billed clock times, break, hours by class, Bill Rates, and amount.
- **R4.** Each exception reason, including SHORT_BREAK, LATE_SUBMISSION, and ADDED_AFTER_SHIFT, is shown in words with what caused it, such as the minutes outside tolerance or the planned break beside the billed one.
- **R5.** A Timesheet whose Bill Rates differ from the contracted Rate Line shows the flag of [`REQ-RATES-0006`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0006) with both rates, the difference, and the Release's bill_rate_reason, before and after approval.
- **R6.** The parts of a split Timesheet are shown together in time order, each with its own Position, Department, and Bill Rates.
- **R7.** A Timesheet still unapproved after its Lock Window closed is marked late on every tab, as [`REQ-TIME-0007`](business-rules.md#req-time-0007) defines.
- **R8.** Approve calls [`REQ-TIME-0002`](business-rules.md#req-time-0002) for one SUBMITTED Timesheet and is disabled, with the reason, while it carries MISSING_TIMES or PENDING_EXPENSE.
- **R9.** Approve all approves in one step every SUBMITTED Timesheet shown for one Shift, one Event, or one work date at a Unit, then lists those left unapproved with the reason.
- **R17.** A locked Timesheet shows when it locked and offers no action.
- **R18.** Each Timesheet opens its change history through [`REQ-SHELL-0011`](every-user.md#req-shell-0011), shown to Unit Users whose scope covers its Unit.
- **R20.** Once a Shift has ended, its page under [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0008`](#req-unit-web-0008) links to this screen filtered to that Shift.
- **R21.** MIXED_WORK_WEEKS is shown with each other Unit's name and the weekday its Work Week starts, beside this Unit's, and with nothing else of the other Timesheet, even when that Unit is outside the User's scope.
- **R22.** This requirement registers the Timesheets screen with [`REQ-SHELL-0007`](every-user.md#req-shell-0007) for subject Timesheet and role UNIT_USER, opened on the tab that lists that Timesheet, at its row.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-TIME-0001` Hold a Timesheet for each assigned Worker](business-rules.md#req-time-0001)
- [`REQ-TIME-0002` Submit and approve Timesheets daily or per Event](business-rules.md#req-time-0002)
- [`REQ-TIME-0005` Auto-approve within tolerance and surface exceptions](business-rules.md#req-time-0005)
- [`REQ-TIME-0007` Lock approved Timesheets after the Lock Window](business-rules.md#req-time-0007)
- [`REQ-RATES-0006` Flag rate variance at booking and on Timesheets](business-rules.md#req-rates-0006)

<a id="req-unit-web-0004"></a>

### Keep the Unit's Worker roster, rate Workers, and report issues

`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0004`

- **Who:** Unit User
- **What:** A Unit User sees the Workers assigned to or who have worked at their Units, with each Unit's rating of them. From the roster they rate a Worker and report an issue to the Agency.
- **Why:**
  - Operators want to rate workers and keep the good ones *(WA-3: Post-shift ratings: favorite, okay to return, block)*
  - VMS requirement: report associate issues *(WA-4: Report an associate issue (conduct, safety, quality, no-show) routed to the agency, with resolution tracking)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) WA-3; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) WA-4; [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §4 Professionals

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Workers screen lists every Worker with an Assignment at a Unit in scope, past or upcoming, and every Worker a Unit in scope has rated.
- **R2.** Each row shows the Worker's name, photo, Agency, Shifts worked at the Unit, the Unit's rating and review, and open issues, with FAVORITE Workers listed first.
- **R3.** The roster filters by Unit, Agency, rating, and Worker name.
- **R4.** Rate sets FAVORITE, OKAY_TO_RETURN, or BLOCK for one Unit, with an optional review, through [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0005`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0005), and replaces that Unit's earlier rating.
- **R5.** Choosing BLOCK first warns that the Worker comes off that Unit's Shifts that have not started and can no longer be assigned or requested there.
- **R6.** Add a Worker finds any active Worker by Agency and name, so a Unit can rate them before their first Shift there.
- **R7.** Rate is offered on every roster row at any time, so a Worker can be rated straight after a Shift or before their first one.
- **R8.** Report an issue takes the category, description, and optional Shift that [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0006.R1`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0006) defines, and saves through that requirement.
- **R9.** The Issues tab lists the issues reported for Units in scope, OPEN first, each with its Worker, Agency, category, description, status, and the Agency's resolution.
- **R11.** This requirement adds Rate and Report an issue to each Worker's row on the Shift's page of [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0008`](#req-unit-web-0008), which open these forms.
- **R12.** This requirement registers the Workers screen with [`REQ-SHELL-0007`](every-user.md#req-shell-0007) for role UNIT_USER: subject Worker opens the roster at that Worker's row, and subject WorkerIssue the Issues tab at that issue.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0001` Hold each Agency's Worker roster](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0001)
- [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0003` Assign named Workers to an accepted Release](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0003)
- [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0005` Rate a Worker as Favorite, Okay to return, or Block](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0005)
- [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0006` Report a Worker issue to the Agency](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0006)
- [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0016` Take Workers off Shifts automatically and recheck their eligibility](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0016)

<a id="req-unit-web-0005"></a>

### See Agencies and their Bill Rates for the Unit

`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0005`

- **Who:** Unit User
- **What:** A Unit User sees the Agencies their Unit can send Shifts to, whether each is approved for it, and each Agency's Bill Rates for the Unit. The screen is view only.
- **Why:** Non-compliant spend persists through local relationships *(RC-11: Soft or hard gates for off-contract rates and non-contracted vendors)*
- **Sources:** [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §3 Supplier Rates; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) RC-11

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** For one Unit at a time, the Agencies screen lists every active Agency, those with an approval covering the Unit first, each marked approved or non-contracted.
- **R2.** Opening an Agency shows, by Position, its APPROVED Rate Lines in effect today or later that price the Unit: Unit lines and lines for the Unit's Market, with the three Bill Rates and effective dates.
- **R3.** Where a Unit line and a Market line both price a Position, the Unit line is marked as the contracted rate, as [`REQ-RATES-0005`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0005) finds it.
- **R4.** The table has Bill Rate columns only, with no Pay Rate or Markup, and no PENDING or SENT_BACK line, as [`REQ-RATES-0001`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0001) limits a Unit User.
- **R5.** A Position view lists each Agency's contracted regular Bill Rate for the Unit today, lowest first, and shows no rate for an Agency without one.
- **R6.** A Unit User cannot change a rate or an approval here; the screen has no edit control.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-AGENCIES-0002` Approve an Agency for part of the org](business-rules.md#req-agencies-0002)
- [`REQ-RATES-0001` Hold each Agency's Rate Card](business-rules.md#req-rates-0001)
- [`REQ-RATES-0005` Find the contracted rate](business-rules.md#req-rates-0005)

<a id="req-unit-web-0006"></a>

### See spend, labor cost, and Timesheet compliance reports for the Unit

`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0006`

- **Who:** Unit User
- **What:** On the Reports screen a Unit User opens the spend dashboard, labor cost as a percentage of sales, and the Timesheet compliance report for their Units. Their Saved Reports are listed there too.
- **Why:**
  - Managers should see total labor cost as % of sales, not a surprise invoice *(REP-3: Labor cost as a percentage of sales by location, using revenue data)*
  - Managers see spend only when the invoice lands, 2–4 weeks later *(REP-7: Operator spend dashboard: spend vs. budget, by supplier, vs. last month)*
  - VMS requirement: timecard compliance reporting *(REP-10: Timecard compliance report: missed breaks and late approvals)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) REP-7; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) REP-3; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) REP-10; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) 6.3

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Reports screen opens on the dashboard of [`REQ-REPORTING-0008`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0008) for the Units in scope, or for the one Unit picked.
- **R2.** The dashboard shows every figure [`REQ-REPORTING-0008`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0008) defines, with its breakdowns by Agency, by Position, and by Unit as tables.
- **R3.** A labor cost section shows LABOR_PCT_OF_SALES from [`REQ-REPORTING-0006`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0006) for a chosen period, and says not available when no date in it has revenue.
- **R4.** A Timesheet compliance section shows, from [`REQ-REPORTING-0010`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0010), the Timesheets with a missed break and the late Timesheets for a chosen period, grouped by a dimension picked from those [`REQ-REPORTING-0002`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0002) lists.
- **R5.** A period is one Work Week, one calendar month, or a range of dates.
- **R6.** The screen embeds the Saved Reports list of [`REQ-SHELL-0012`](every-user.md#req-shell-0012).
- **R7.** Ask a question opens the assistant of [`REQ-ASSISTANT-0001`](every-user.md#req-assistant-0001), where [`REQ-ASSISTANT-0004`](every-user.md#req-assistant-0004) answers a typed question and can save it.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-REPORTING-0006` Show labor cost as a percentage of sales](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0006)
- [`REQ-REPORTING-0008` Show Unit Users spend against budget, by Agency, and against last month](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0008)
- [`REQ-REPORTING-0010` Report Timesheet compliance: missed breaks and late approvals](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0010)

<a id="req-unit-web-0007"></a>

### List the Unit's Shifts by date

`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0007` · first slice

- **Who:** Unit User
- **What:** A Unit User sees the Shifts of the Units in their scope grouped by date, with how much of each is filled and by which Agencies.
- **Why:** Events need several roles at once *(SC-2: Multiple positions in one request)*
- **Sources:** [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §2 Shifts; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) SC-2

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Shifts list shows every Shift at the Units in scope, grouped by work date: Shifts not yet ended first, soonest first, then ended Shifts, newest first.
- **R2.** Each row shows the Position, Unit, Department, start and end, ASSIGNED Workers over headcount, the Agencies holding a PENDING or ACCEPTED Release, and the status.
- **R3.** A row whose Shift has not started and has unsent headcount shows how much is unsent.
- **R4.** The list filters by Unit, date range, Position, Agency, status, and Shifts with unsent headcount.
- **R7.** The list's CSV download, through [`REQ-SHELL-0010`](every-user.md#req-shell-0010), carries each Shift's id in a shift_id column.
- **R8.** A CANCELLED Shift stays in the list, marked cancelled.

<a id="req-unit-web-0008"></a>

### Follow one Shift and change it from its page

`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0008` · first slice

- **Who:** Unit User
- **What:** A Shift's page shows its details, its Releases with each Agency's answer, and its Workers by name. From it a Unit User edits or cancels the Shift, sends headcount, and withdraws a pending Release.
- **Why:**
  - Headcounts change constantly and climb as the event nears *(SC-3: Fast edits to open requests (add headcount, change times))*
  - Common at large Levy events *(SC-5: Overbooking and on-the-day add (e.g. 50 needed, 55 arrive))*
  - VMS requirement: onboarding instructions (attire, directions, parking) *(SC-6: Structured shift instructions shared with the agency and sent to workers by text or email: parking, entrance, directions, site contact, attire)*
  - Compass needs to know who is actually coming on site *(WA-1: Agency roster: agencies assign named workers to allocated shifts)*
- **Sources:** [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §2 Shifts; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) SC-3; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) WA-1

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The page shows the Shift's Position, Unit, Department, start, end, planned break, headcount, status, and its five site instruction fields.
- **R2.** It lists each Release with its Agency, headcount, status, the three Bill Rates sent, any bill_rate_reason, non_contracted_reason, or decline_reason, and whether it was off-contract or non-contracted.
- **R3.** Under each Release it lists the ASSIGNED Workers with name, photo, and Agency, and shows Open for each unit of its headcount not yet assigned.
- **R4.** Unsent headcount shows as its own line with Send, which opens the send step of [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0009`](#req-unit-web-0009).
- **R5.** Each ASSIGNED Worker shows whether [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0005`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0005) finds them eligible before the Shift starts, and their is_eligible_at_start after it.
- **R8.** Workers removed from the Shift are listed below those assigned, each with the removal reason and time.
- **R9.** Until the Shift ends, Edit changes headcount, date, times, planned break, and site instructions through [`REQ-ORDERING-0003`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0003).
- **R10.** Until the Shift starts, Cancel calls [`REQ-ORDERING-0003`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0003) once the User confirms, and the page then shows its Releases cancelled and its Workers removed.
- **R12.** A PENDING Release offers Withdraw, which calls [`REQ-DISPATCH-0001`](business-rules.md#req-dispatch-0001).
- **R14.** Once the Shift has ended, Edit, Cancel, and Send are gone.
- **R16.** The page embeds the Shift's change history through [`REQ-SHELL-0011`](every-user.md#req-shell-0011), shown to Unit Users whose scope covers the Unit.
- **R18.** This requirement registers the Shift's page with [`REQ-SHELL-0007`](every-user.md#req-shell-0007) for subject Release and role UNIT_USER, and a notification about a Release opens the page of that Release's Shift.
- **R19.** This requirement makes each row of the Shifts list of [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0007`](#req-unit-web-0007) open that Shift's page.

<a id="req-unit-web-0009"></a>

### Pick an Agency and a rate in one send step

`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0009` · first slice

- **Who:** Unit User
- **What:** Wherever a Unit User sends a Shift, one step lists the Agencies with their contracted rates and takes the headcount and any other rate with a reason.
- **Why:**
  - Operators don't know the contracted rate when they book *(SC-1: Contracted rate set as default upon booking)*
  - Agreed starting flow: a unit posts a shift, then the agency assigns a worker *(SC-7: Send each request to a chosen agency)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) SC-1; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) SC-7; [Demo feedback](https://docs.google.com/document/d/14AQi9DSbYzvEEijmSjCUajHHymowKWYXTPcO3hDEkWc/edit) a single agency, then request worker as a nested feature

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The step lists every active Agency approved for the Unit with its contracted regular Bill Rate for the Shift, as [`REQ-ORDERING-0002`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0002) returns it, lowest rate first.
- **R2.** The Agencies [`REQ-ORDERING-0002.R2`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0002) marks non-contracted follow the approved ones, and an Agency it gives no contracted rate shows none.
- **R3.** Picking an Agency fills in its contracted regular Bill Rate and the Shift's unsent headcount, which the User may lower to no less than 1.
- **R4.** The User may type another regular Bill Rate, and must type one when there is no contracted rate; either way the step requires a reason, saved as bill_rate_reason.
- **R5.** Before sending, the step shows what [`REQ-ORDERING-0002.R4`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0002) returns for the picked Agency and rate, and names the gate when the send would be refused.
- **R8.** Send calls [`REQ-DISPATCH-0001`](business-rules.md#req-dispatch-0001) for the Release, and a refused send saves nothing.
- **R9.** When the Agency already holds a PENDING or ACCEPTED Release on the Shift, the step says the headcount will be added to it at the rates already sent.
- **R11.** Once the Shift has started, the step offers only Agencies that hold an ACCEPTED Release on it.
- **R12.** When the picked Agency is non-contracted and [`REQ-RATES-0007`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0007) answers SOFT, the step takes a second reason, saved as non_contracted_reason under [`REQ-DISPATCH-0001.R9`](business-rules.md#req-dispatch-0001).
- **R13.** When headcount is added to a Release, the step asks for a bill_rate_reason or non_contracted_reason only where [`REQ-DISPATCH-0001.R19`](business-rules.md#req-dispatch-0001) needs one the Release does not hold.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-ORDERING-0002` Show the contracted rate for each Shift line while booking](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0002)
- [`REQ-DISPATCH-0001` Send a Shift's headcount to a chosen Agency](business-rules.md#req-dispatch-0001)
- [`REQ-RATES-0007` Gate off-contract rates and non-contracted Agencies](business-rules.md#req-rates-0007)
- [`REQ-AGENCIES-0002` Approve an Agency for part of the org](business-rules.md#req-agencies-0002)

<a id="req-unit-web-0010"></a>

### Name Events and see each Event's projected and actual cost

`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0010`

- **Who:** Unit User
- **What:** A Unit User names Events for a Unit, attaches Shifts to them, and sees each Event's projected cost beside its actual cost.
- **Why:** Units want to know what last Friday's banquet actually cost, and some clients expect it the next morning *(REP-2: Event-level cost: group shifts into an event and see projected vs. actual, available the next morning)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) REP-2

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Events screen lists the Events of the Units in scope, latest Shift date first, each with its Unit, dates, number of Shifts, projected cost, actual cost, and difference from [`REQ-REPORTING-0004`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0004).
- **R2.** Actual cost shows its APPROVED_SPEND and PENDING_SPEND parts, with the estimated part of PENDING_SPEND apart and labelled as an estimate, as [`REQ-REPORTING-0004.R4`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0004) requires.
- **R3.** New Event takes a Unit and a name, and Rename changes the name, both through [`REQ-ORDERING-0011`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0011).
- **R4.** Opening an Event lists its Shifts with Position, start and end, headcount, and Agencies, and each row opens the Shift's page of [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0008`](#req-unit-web-0008).
- **R5.** From an Event the User attaches Shifts of the same Unit that have no Event and detaches Shifts, through [`REQ-ORDERING-0011`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0011).
- **R6.** Approve Timesheets opens the Timesheets screen of [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0003`](#req-unit-web-0003) filtered to the Event, where they are approved in one step.
- **R7.** This requirement adds an Event field to each line of the booking form of [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0002`](#req-unit-web-0002), and after the Request is created the line's Shift is attached through [`REQ-ORDERING-0011`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0011).
- **R8.** This requirement adds each Shift's Event to the rows and the filters of the Shifts list of [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0007`](#req-unit-web-0007).
- **R9.** This requirement adds to the Shift's page of [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0008`](#req-unit-web-0008) the Shift's Event and a control that attaches the Shift to an Event of its Unit, moves it to another, or detaches it, through [`REQ-ORDERING-0011`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0011).

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-ORDERING-0011` Group Shifts into an Event](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0011)
- [`REQ-REPORTING-0004` Show an Event's projected and actual cost the next morning](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0004)

<a id="req-unit-web-0011"></a>

### Keep Request templates and the Unit's booking defaults

`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0011`

- **Who:** Unit User
- **What:** On the Setup screen a Unit User keeps a Unit's Request templates, the default Department for each Position, and its default site instructions.
- **Why:**
  - Entering requests is slow and repetitive *(SC-11: Request templates and location defaults (e.g. game-day package: 5 bartenders, 4 concessions))*
  - VMS requirement: onboarding instructions (attire, directions, parking) *(SC-6: Structured shift instructions shared with the agency and sent to workers by text or email: parking, entrance, directions, site contact, attire)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) SC-11; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) SC-6

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Setup screen is for one Unit and has three sections: Request templates, Position defaults, and default site instructions.
- **R2.** Request templates lists the Unit's templates by name with their lines, and creates, changes, and deletes a template through [`REQ-ORDERING-0007`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0007).
- **R3.** A template line takes a Position, headcount, start time, and end time, and optionally a Department and a planned break; an end before the start must be confirmed as next day.
- **R4.** Each template offers Book, which opens the booking form of [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0002`](#req-unit-web-0002) with that template picked.
- **R5.** Position defaults lists each Position with its default Department at the Unit and sets or changes it through [`REQ-ORDERING-0007`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0007).
- **R6.** Default site instructions shows the Unit's default parking, entrance, directions, site contact, and attire, and saves changes through [`REQ-ORG-0002`](business-rules.md#req-org-0002).
- **R7.** The Unit's address, timezone, Company, Work Week start, secured-site flag, and each Department's name, cost center code, and address are shown read-only.
- **R8.** This requirement adds Start from template to the booking form of [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0002`](#req-unit-web-0002), which lists the Unit's Request templates and, for the one picked and a date, fills the lines through [`REQ-ORDERING-0007`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0007).
- **R9.** On that form, picking a Position that has a default Department at the Unit fills the Department in.
- **R10.** Each Department on that screen shows its default parking, entrance, directions, site contact, and attire, and the Unit User can change them through [`REQ-ORG-0002`](business-rules.md#req-org-0002).
- **R11.** The Setup screen also shows the Unit's primary operator and, from [`REQ-ORG-0011`](business-rules.md#req-org-0011), its Account Manager, Account Owner, and Support Lead, each with name, email, and phone.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-ORDERING-0007` Save Request templates and Unit defaults](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0007)
- [`REQ-ORG-0002` Add a Unit and its Departments](business-rules.md#req-org-0002)
- [`REQ-ORG-0011` Assign Instawork's account team to parts of the org](business-rules.md#req-org-0011)

<a id="req-unit-web-0012"></a>

### Enter Tip Pools and cashier PIN tips, and keep the PIN map

`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0012`

- **Who:** Unit User
- **What:** A Unit User enters Tip Pools and cashier PIN tips for their Units and sees how each pool was split. They also keep the map of cashier PINs to Workers.
- **Why:** Tip pooling is manual; stadiums use cashier PINs *(TS-11: Tips entry (bulk or chat), split by hours worked)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) TS-11; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) 4.4; [Demo sessions](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Xy3QVWr-aVVV6mpMxWsH6kb987IzwVPXDQ1iW8k83Bo/edit) Timesheets, Tips & Expenses

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Tips screen lists the Tip Pools and cashier PIN tips of the Units in scope, newest work date first, each with its Unit, work date, amount, and who entered it.
- **R2.** New Tip Pool takes a Unit, a work date, an amount, and optionally one Shift or one Event, never both, and saves through [`REQ-TIPS-0004`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0004).
- **R3.** Opening a pool shows its Shift or Event when set, any unallocated amount, and every covered Timesheet with its Worker, Agency, share, and counted minutes ([`REQ-TIPS-0004.R7`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0004)), marked as scheduled where hours are not entered.
- **R4.** Change and Delete are offered on a pool or a PIN tip until a Timesheet it covers or holds a share on locks; after that the row says it is fixed.
- **R5.** New PIN tip takes a Unit, a work date, a cashier PIN, and an amount, and saves the whole amount to that PIN's Worker through [`REQ-TIPS-0004`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0004).
- **R6.** The PIN map tab lists each cashier PIN with its Unit, Worker, valid_from, and valid_to, and adds a mapping through [`REQ-TIPS-0004`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0004).
- **R7.** Upload tips opens the Uploads send step of [`REQ-SHELL-0008`](every-user.md#req-shell-0008) with TIPS picked, and a pool typed in the assistant becomes a Proposal whose summary lists each share.
- **R8.** Each mapping offers End, which sets or changes its valid_to through [`REQ-TIPS-0004`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0004); its PIN, Worker, and valid_from cannot be changed.
- **R9.** A new pool, a change to one, or a PIN tip that [`REQ-TIPS-0004.R13`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0004) refuses shows that a Timesheet it would cover is locked.
- **R10.** An opened pool shows the earliest lock time, as [`REQ-TIME-0007.R1`](business-rules.md#req-time-0007) defines it, among its covered APPROVED Timesheets as the last time it can be changed, or says that none is approved yet.
- **R11.** This requirement registers the Tip Pool's page with [`REQ-SHELL-0007`](every-user.md#req-shell-0007) for subject TipPool and role UNIT_USER.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-TIPS-0004` Split Tip Pools by hours and credit cashier PIN tips](business-rules.md#req-tips-0004)

X's hours are in that night and its Timesheets lock on Sunday; Y's hours arrive on Monday. Splitting only among Timesheets that have hours gives X's Workers $200 each and Y's Workers nothing.

<a id="req-unit-web-0013"></a>

### Issue and revoke badges at secured Units

`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0013`

- **Who:** Unit User
- **What:** At a secured Unit, a Unit User sees each Worker's badge and system access request and marks it issued or revoked.
- **Why:** VMS requirement: manages badges and system access *(WA-17: Badge and system access requests for workers at secured sites)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) WA-17

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Badges tab of the Workers screen of [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0004`](#req-unit-web-0004) shows when a Unit in scope is a secured site, and lists its BadgeRequests with Worker, Agency, status, and requested time.
- **R2.** REQUESTED rows come first, oldest first, followed by ISSUED and then REVOKED rows.
- **R3.** Mark issued is offered on a REQUESTED row and Revoke on a REQUESTED or ISSUED row, both through [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0006`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0006); a REVOKED row offers nothing.
- **R4.** An ISSUED or REVOKED row shows who marked it and when.
- **R5.** At a secured Unit, this requirement adds each ASSIGNED Worker's BadgeRequest status to the Shift's page of [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0008`](#req-unit-web-0008).

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0006` Request badge and system access at secured Units](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0006)

<a id="req-unit-web-0014"></a>

### Unit Home: to-dos and a spend summary

`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0014`

- **Who:** Unit User
- **What:** A Unit User's Home lists their to-dos and a summary of spend for the Units in their scope.
- **Why:** Managers see spend only when the invoice lands, 2–4 weeks later *(REP-7: Operator spend dashboard: spend vs. budget, by supplier, vs. last month)*
- **Sources:** [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §1 Dashboard / Profile; [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §1 Detailed requirements; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) REP-7

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** Home ([`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0001`](#req-unit-web-0001)) shows the to-do list of [`REQ-SHELL-0003`](every-user.md#req-shell-0003) with three lines: Timesheets to review, headcount to send, and badge requests to issue.
- **R2.** Timesheets to review counts every SUBMITTED Timesheet in scope, shows their total billed amount and how many are late, and opens the exception list of [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0003`](#req-unit-web-0003).
- **R3.** Headcount to send counts Shifts in scope that have not started and have unsent headcount, shows the time until the earliest starts, and opens the Shifts list of [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0007`](#req-unit-web-0007) filtered to them.
- **R4.** Badge requests to issue counts REQUESTED BadgeRequests at secured Units in scope, shows the age of the oldest, and opens the Badges tab of [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0013`](#req-unit-web-0013).
- **R5.** The second section is the spend summary from [`REQ-REPORTING-0008`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0008): the month to date against budget and the prior month, and the Work Week to date against the prior Work Week.
- **R6.** Each spend figure shows its APPROVED_SPEND and PENDING_SPEND parts, and the summary links to the Reports screen of [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0006`](#req-unit-web-0006) for the breakdowns.

<a id="req-unit-web-0015"></a>

### Correct, reject, split, or mark a no-show on a Timesheet as a Unit User

`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0015`

- **Who:** Unit User
- **What:** On the Timesheets screen a Unit User corrects a Timesheet's hours, rejects it to the Agency, splits it by role, or marks a no-show, each with a reason. They can also load corrections from a file.
- **Why:**
  - Mid-shift role and rate changes are rarely captured *(TS-10: Split a shift by time and position for mid-shift role changes (e.g. bartender → barback))*
  - Approvals take too long; operators would comply if it took minutes *(TS-7: Exception-based approval: auto-approve within schedule tolerance, surface the rest on a dashboard)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) TS-10; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) TS-7; [Demo sessions](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Xy3QVWr-aVVV6mpMxWsH6kb987IzwVPXDQ1iW8k83Bo/edit) Timesheets, Tips & Expenses; [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §2 Shifts

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** On the Timesheets screen of [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0003`](#req-unit-web-0003), Correct opens the clock_in, clock_out, and break_minutes of a SUBMITTED or APPROVED Timesheet that is not locked, requires a reason, and saves through [`REQ-TIME-0006`](business-rules.md#req-time-0006).
- **R2.** On a Timesheet with OUTSIDE_TOLERANCE, Use scheduled times makes the one-step correction of [`REQ-TIME-0006.R5`](business-rules.md#req-time-0006), still with a reason.
- **R3.** Reject returns a SUBMITTED Timesheet to the Agency through [`REQ-TIME-0006`](business-rules.md#req-time-0006) with a required reason, and is not offered on an APPROVED one.
- **R4.** Split by role takes a switch time, a new Position, Department, or both, any break minutes to move, and a reason, and saves through [`REQ-TIME-0008`](business-rules.md#req-time-0008).
- **R5.** No-show sets or clears the mark on any Timesheet that is not locked, including a DRAFT or REJECTED one, with a reason, through [`REQ-TIME-0009`](business-rules.md#req-time-0009).
- **R6.** Upload corrections opens the Uploads send step of [`REQ-SHELL-0008`](every-user.md#req-shell-0008) with TIMESHEETS picked; [`REQ-TIME-0003`](business-rules.md#req-time-0003) saves the accepted rows as corrections, each with the reason in its reason column.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-TIME-0003` Read Timesheets in any format and match them to Shifts](business-rules.md#req-time-0003)
- [`REQ-TIME-0006` Correct or reject a Timesheet with a reason](business-rules.md#req-time-0006)
- [`REQ-TIME-0008` Split a Timesheet when a Worker changes role](business-rules.md#req-time-0008)
- [`REQ-TIME-0009` Mark a Worker as a no-show](business-rules.md#req-time-0009)

<a id="req-unit-web-0016"></a>

### Decide Expenses and see tips on the Unit's Timesheets

`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0016`

- **Who:** Unit User
- **What:** On the Timesheets screen a Unit User sees each Timesheet's tips and Expenses, and approves or rejects each pending Expense.
- **Why:**
  - Expenses flow through the same process *(TS-12: Expense entry and approval)*
  - Tip pooling is manual; stadiums use cashier PINs *(TS-11: Tips entry (bulk or chat), split by hours worked)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) TS-12; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) TS-11; [Demo sessions](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Xy3QVWr-aVVV6mpMxWsH6kb987IzwVPXDQ1iW8k83Bo/edit) Timesheets, Tips & Expenses

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** Each row of the Timesheets screen of [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0003`](#req-unit-web-0003) also shows the Timesheet's tips and Expenses.
- **R2.** Each PENDING Expense on a SUBMITTED Timesheet shows its kind, amount, and note with Approve and Reject, which call [`REQ-TIPS-0002`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0002); Reject requires a reason.
- **R3.** Tips show as each TipAllocation with its source: a Tip Pool share, a cashier PIN tip, or a tip the Agency entered, which is why the Timesheet carries AGENCY_TIP.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-TIPS-0001` Hold each Timesheet's tips and take the tips an Agency enters](business-rules.md#req-tips-0001)
- [`REQ-TIPS-0002` Add and approve expenses](business-rules.md#req-tips-0002)

**Open questions it rests on**

- [D-28](open-questions.md#d-28) Who enters tips?

<a id="req-unit-web-0017"></a>

### Repeat a Request weekly and act on its series

`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0017`

- **Who:** Unit User
- **What:** A Unit User makes a Request repeat on chosen weekdays when booking it. The Shifts of one repeating line show as a series, which can be sent, edited, or cancelled together.
- **Why:** Recurring needs shouldn't be re-entered *(SC-4: Recurring and chained shifts (multi-week assignments booked as a block))*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) SC-4

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** This requirement adds a repeat option to the booking form of [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0002`](#req-unit-web-0002), which takes weekdays, an interval in weeks, and an end date, under [`REQ-ORDERING-0004`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0004).
- **R2.** On the Shifts list of [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0007`](#req-unit-web-0007), the Shifts of one recurring Request line are marked as a series.
- **R3.** For a series, the send step of [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0009`](#req-unit-web-0009) sends every chosen Shift of the Request to the Agency under [`REQ-DISPATCH-0001.R15`](business-rules.md#req-dispatch-0001), and then lists any Shift whose send was refused.
- **R4.** On a Shift in a series, Edit and Cancel on the Shift's page of [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0008`](#req-unit-web-0008) ask whether to apply to this Shift or to every Shift of the series not yet started.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-ORDERING-0004` Book recurring and chained Shifts](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0004)
- [`REQ-DISPATCH-0001` Send a Shift's headcount to a chosen Agency](business-rules.md#req-dispatch-0001)

**Open questions it rests on**

- [D-20](open-questions.md#d-20) How does a recurring Request repeat?
- [D-107](open-questions.md#d-107) How can the first slice be used before every screen and feature exists?
- [D-165](open-questions.md#d-165) Does a change to a recurring Shift apply to one Shift or to its series?
- [D-166](open-questions.md#d-166) Must an Agency accept a chained block as a whole and keep the same Workers on every Shift?

<a id="req-unit-web-0018"></a>

### Record the headcount needed when a Unit overbooks

`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0018`

- **Who:** Unit User
- **What:** When a Unit User books more Workers than needed, they state the headcount needed on the booking form or on the Shift's page. The Shift's page shows both numbers.
- **Why:** Common at large Levy events *(SC-5: Overbooking and on-the-day add (e.g. 50 needed, 55 arrive))*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) SC-5

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** This requirement adds to each line of the booking form of [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0002`](#req-unit-web-0002) a needed headcount below its headcount, which [`REQ-ORDERING-0005`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0005) records as overbooking.
- **R2.** The Shift's page of [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0008`](#req-unit-web-0008) shows the needed headcount beside the headcount, and its Edit also changes the needed headcount through [`REQ-ORDERING-0005`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0005).

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-ORDERING-0005` Overbook and add headcount on the day](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0005)

**Open questions it rests on**

- [D-19](open-questions.md#d-19) When a Unit books more Workers than it needs, such as 55 for 50, which Workers are billed?
- [D-107](open-questions.md#d-107) How can the first slice be used before every screen and feature exists?

<a id="req-unit-web-0019"></a>

### Upload a Shifts file from the Shifts list

`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0019`

- **Who:** Unit User
- **What:** From the Shifts list a Unit User uploads a SHIFTS file to create or change many Shifts at once.
- **Why:** Not given in Compass's sheet; the sources below are where it comes from.
- **Sources:** [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §2 Shifts; [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §6 Templates

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** This requirement adds Upload Shifts to the Shifts list of [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0007`](#req-unit-web-0007), which opens the Uploads send step of [`REQ-SHELL-0008`](every-user.md#req-shell-0008) with SHIFTS picked, whose rows [`REQ-ORDERING-0014`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0014) checks and saves.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-ORDERING-0014` Load Shifts from a file](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0014)

**Open questions it rests on**

- [D-107](open-questions.md#d-107) How can the first slice be used before every screen and feature exists?

<a id="req-unit-web-0020"></a>

### Flag a Bill Rate above its peers in the send step

`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0020`

- **Who:** Unit User
- **What:** In the send step a Unit User sees when the Bill Rate about to be sent is above the Peer Rate.
- **Why:** Units need to see deviations and push back on vendors *(RC-12: Rate review: e.g. when an agency's rates run 15%+ above peer rates, ask the agency to lower the rate or justify it)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) 1.4; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) RC-12

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** This requirement adds a flag to the send step of [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0009`](#req-unit-web-0009) on a regular Bill Rate that [`REQ-RATES-0008`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0008) judges to be above the Peer Rate.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-RATES-0008` Ask an Agency to review a rate above its peers](business-rules.md#req-rates-0008)

**Open questions it rests on**

- [D-12](open-questions.md#d-12) Is the Peer Rate a simple average, or weighted by volume or rating?
- [D-107](open-questions.md#d-107) How can the first slice be used before every screen and feature exists?

<a id="req-unit-web-0021"></a>

### Request Workers by name when sending a Shift and on its page

`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0021`

- **Who:** Unit User
- **What:** When sending a Shift to an Agency, or later on the Shift's page, a Unit User names the Workers they want from that Agency. The page shows each request and the Agency's answer.
- **Why:** Favorite rosters must carry over (one operator always requests the same 20 people) *(WA-2: Request specific workers, linked to the worker record)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) WA-2; [Demo feedback](https://docs.google.com/document/d/14AQi9DSbYzvEEijmSjCUajHHymowKWYXTPcO3hDEkWc/edit) a single agency, then request worker as a nested feature

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** This requirement adds Request Workers by name to the send step of [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0009`](#req-unit-web-0009), which lists the picked Agency's active Workers, those the Unit rated FAVORITE first, and leaves out Workers the Unit rated BLOCK.
- **R2.** After Send saves the Release, the step calls [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0004`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0004) for each Worker named, and a refused send requests nobody.
- **R3.** On the Shift's page of [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0008`](#req-unit-web-0008), each PENDING or ACCEPTED Release offers Request Workers, which lists that Agency's Workers as R1 does and saves each one picked through [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0004`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0004).
- **R4.** The Shift's page lists Workers requested by name as REQUESTED or UNAVAILABLE, with the Agency's unavailable_reason, and each offers Withdraw until the Shift starts, through [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0004.R7`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0004).

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0004` Request specific Workers by name](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0004)
- [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0005` Rate a Worker as Favorite, Okay to return, or Block](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0005)

- [D-95](open-questions.md#d-95) Can a Unit take back a request for a Worker by name?

- [D-190](open-questions.md#d-190) Which Workers can a Unit request by name?
